datasets.purpose: Acutely Food Insecure Population Estimates in different scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) surveys across Central African Republic to estimate acutely food insecure populations under different scenarios. Population estimates were aggregated and compiled into a time series dataset covering 2019, representing direct impacts of food security crises on vulnerable populations.
